title: A Message to a Friend
subtitle: 考点：学校对比 / different from / How about
passage: Dear Jenny, How is your school? My new school is different from my old one. It is very modern. Every classroom has a smart whiteboard and a big screen. The computers are amazing.
Most classes start at 8:00. We have lunch in the delicious dining hall at 12:00. How about your school? Please send me a message soon. Bye for now! Linda
vocab: different from 与……不同 · modern 现代的 · amazing 令人惊奇的 · most 大多数 · How about…? ……怎么样 · send 发送 · Bye for now 再见

questions.stem: What is Linda's new school like?

questions.why: Most classes start at 8:00. 12:00 是午饭时间。

questions.stem: What does Linda want Jenny to do?
questions.why: Please send me a message soon.
